claim.claim-text: 1. An air-to-ground communication system comprising:
2. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the transceiver is configured to operate as a secondary user on at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels.

3. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the transceiver is configures to allow a primary user to transmit and receive on at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels.
4. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 3, wherein the primary user comprises a satellite communication system.

5. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the communication service comprises a digital modulation service and wherein the transceiver is configured to operate as a secondary user within at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels using the communication service.

6. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the computer processor is configured to cause the transceiver to monitor the at least two communication channels for at least one source of interference by measuring a block error ratio (BLER) associated with the communication service.

7. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the computer processor is configured to cause the transceiver to monitor the at least two communication channels during a guard time of a time division duplex (TDD) communication protocol for the presence of at least one signal transmitted by a primary user.

8. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the computer processor is configured to cause the transceiver to avoid the at least one source of interference by recording the channel associated with the interference in a computer memory, and wherein the computer processor is configured to cause the transceiver to schedule at least one communication channel that differs from the channel associated with the interference.

9. The air-to-ground communication system of claim 1, wherein the computer processor is configured to cause the transceiver to receive at least two acknowledgement signals associated with at least two of the communication channels, wherein the computer processor is configured to record in a computer memory the absence of one of the acknowledgements as indicating the presence of interference on the channel corresponding to the acknowledgement, and wherein the computer processor is configured to record in the computer memory the absence of two of the acknowledgements as indicating the presence of environmental interference.
10. A method, performed by a computer processor comprising:
11. The method of claim 10, wherein the transceiver is configured to operate as a secondary user on at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels.
12. The method of claim 10, wherein the transceiver is configured to allow a primary user to transmit and receive on at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels.
13. The method of claim 12, wherein the primary user comprises a satellite communication system.

14. The method of claim 10, wherein the communication service comprises a digital communication service, and wherein the transceiver is configured to operate as a secondary user within at least one of the air-to-ground communication channels.

15. The method of claim 10, comprising configuring the transceiver to monitor the at least two communication channels for at least one source of interference by measuring a block error ratio (BLER) associated with the communication service.

16. The method of claim 10, comprising configuring the transceiver to monitor the at least two communication channels during a guard time of a time division duplex (TDD) digital communications protocol for the presence of at least one signal transmitted by a primary user.
17. The method of claim 10, comprising:

configuring the transceiver to avoid the at least one source of interference by recording the channel associated with the interference in a computer memory, and configuring the transceiver to schedule at least one communication channel that differs from the channel associated with the interference.
18. The method of claim 10, comprising:

configuring the transceiver to receive at least two acknowledgement signals associated with at least two of the communication channels, recording in a computer memory the absence of one of the acknowledgements as indicating the presence of interference on the channel corresponding to the acknowledgement, and recording in the computer memory the absence of two of the acknowledgements as indicating the presence of environmental interference.
19. The method of claim 10, wherein at least one of the communication channels is shared with a Ku band satellite service.
20. The method of claim 17, comprising:

retrieving from the computer memory the communication channel associated with the interference, configuring the transceiver to monitor the communication channel for the absence of transmissions from a primary user of the communication channel, and configuring the transceiver to resume transmitting and receiving data on the communication channel in the absence of transmissions from the primary user of the communication channel.
